chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn Yahya, altogether, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'd, from Muhammad ibn Aslam, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Adayy, who said: 'Muhammad ibn Sulayman dictated to me, from Is'haq ibn Ammar, who said:'

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Be good, O Is'haq, to my friends to the best of your ability. And whenever a believer is good to a believer and assists him, it scratches the face of Iblis and ulcerates his heart.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual effect of a believer showing kindness to another believer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) instructs Is'haq ibn Ammar to show kindness to his *awliya'* (friends/devotees), linking this social virtue directly to cosmic spiritual dynamics. The imagery of Iblis's face being 'scratched' and his heart 'ulcerated' signifies that the unity and mutual support of believers actively diminish Satan's influence, a concept deeply rooted in Shia theology regarding the spiritual warfare between the faithful and the devil.
